groupings.title: Start here
groupings.description: Say “publish my app for review”. It checks the app itself for what App Review rejects, fixes everything App Store Connect's API allows, and submits when nothing is left. iOS 27 ready, no dependencies.

groupings.title: Get the listing right
groupings.description: Screenshots at Apple's exact sizes — iPhone 6.9", iPad, iPhone Duo — and the 2026 age-rating questionnaire, written for you.

groupings.title: Sell
groupings.description: Subscription plans, free trials and lifetime unlocks: created, priced, localized and submitted with your version.

groupings.title: Test and ship
groupings.description: Builds to TestFlight testers with notes and beta review, and EAS signing that never burns a certificate slot by accident.

groupings.title: After review
groupings.description: Turn a rejection into a resubmission, and answer customer reviews — each reply published only after you approve it.
